prompts.text:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: a NEW DearBody Philippines Mistened Narcissus product-page lifestyle header photograph, wide 2:1 landscape, high-resolution around 1774 by 887. This is a replacement banner, not a gallery or a poster. No added headline; the website uses live text.
References: Image 1 is the authoritative real MISTENED NARCISSUS bottle, label, clear liquid and black cap. Image 2 is canonical bottle geometry and 50 ml scale ONLY; do not copy its Sunset Cocktail name, black label, peach liquid, props or setting.
Create a fresh, believable Filipino weekend moment: exactly ONE adult Filipina woman, about 26, medium brown skin, dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a berry-red cotton T-shirt and cream relaxed trousers, sitting comfortably on a simple wooden bench at the edge of an ordinary small covered roller-skating venue in Metro Manila. She has a relaxed spontaneous smile, looking slightly toward her small bag as she lifts her capped Mistened Narcissus bottle from its open top. One hand holds the bottle securely around its side without covering the front label; the other rests naturally on the canvas bag. The bottle is a real small 50 ml bottle relative to her normal hands. She is mid-action, not posing in a studio or presenting a giant bottle.
A pair of pale-lavender roller skates can rest together beside her on the bench at the far right. The venue has an ordinary smooth concrete floor, a simple burgundy-painted metal barrier and plain cream plaster walls, daylight entering from an open side at the far right. It must look like an attainable real place, not a luxury set or fantasy rink. No signage or posters. No other people, bodies, silhouettes, reflections, photographs or printed faces anywhere.
Composition for website cropping is critical: left 45% remains a quiet uninterrupted warm cream wall for live page copy. The whole woman stays in right 54–94%; face centered around x75%, y27%, entire head and hair with 12% clear margin above. Bottle front around x75%, y50%, well above the bottom. Wide environmental waist-up/bench portrait with elbow, hands and bag naturally contained on the right. Keep face and bottle vertically aligned in a narrow x66–83% region so a phone crop still includes both. Bottom quarter may contain bench, bag or clothing, not the face or bottle. Clear architectural perspective and contact shadows.
Exact product identity: tall straight-sided cylindrical clear-glass bottle, restrained rounded shoulder, thick clear glass base, CLEAR COLOURLESS liquid, small straight glossy BLACK CYLINDRICAL CAP seated on the bottle, thin silver collar belonging to bottle beneath it. White/ivory rectangular paper label with crisp black words "MISTENED" over "NARCISSUS", authentic small DearBody monogram and "PARFUM" above "LONDON" from physical reference. Correct spelling, preserve label hierarchy and geometry. Do not enlarge, widen, taper or miniaturize the bottle. Cap is a continuous black shell without added silver hardware. No spraying or detached cap; no second bottle or package.
Art direction: lively, warm, fun and light; candid Filipino personality, berry and lavender accents balanced by cream and burgundy, real skin texture, natural anatomy, gently sunlit exposure, physically coherent lighting, polished editorial photography. No berries/flowers/ingredient props or scent claims. No fantastical architecture, glowing floors, impossible railing, melting objects, extra fingers, plastic skin, visible other people, watermark, headline or promotional typography.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit image1, the new Mistened Narcissus Filipino rink-side banner. Keep this same one smiling adult Filipina, berry-red T-shirt, cream trousers, cream canvas bag, pale-lavender pair of skates, natural daylight and real covered roller venue. Keep exactly one person total.
Correct the CAMERA FRAMING, not the product or story. The current head is cut off at top and the woman and bottle are too far left. Use a visibly WIDER environmental photograph, reducing the woman's rendered size by about25%, moving her complete figure and her bench belongings to the RIGHT. Leave comfortable blank wall/architecture ABOVE her complete hair: hair's top must be around15% of imageheight. Face centre should be at x76%,y30%, bottle aroundx71%,y49%, both clearly inside right62–86% so a vertical phone crop includes both. Keep whole face/head and holding hand fully visible. Her LEFTMOST elbow should start beyond55% of the imagewidth. Left45% is quiet cream wall for editable copy. No blank white padding: naturally extend the same real location through a wider camera view.
Retain exact small50ml cylindrical MISTENED NARCISSUS bottle matching physical reference image2. Image3 is shape/scaleONLY, nevercopySunsetCocktailidentity. Clear colourless liquid, straight cylinder, thick clearbase, seatedcompact glossyblackcap, thin silverbottlecollar, exactwhite label with "MISTENED" / "NARCISSUS" and authentic smallmonogram "PARFUM" / "LONDON". Normal hand anatomy, no duplicatefingers or miniaturebottle. Keep readablelabelwithoutmakingbottlelarge.
Maintain2:1landscape at1774x887, naturalcontrast, warmfunlightmood. Do not add any people, reflections, signs, headlines, watermarks or promotionaltype. No fantasy architecture. Complete head with clearheadroom is essential.
